proposals: DGCI&S should publish its Service Exports Reporting Form data as a queryable database alongside TRADESTAT and reconcile it each year with RBI’s Balance of Payments services figures, so goods and services trade can be combined from the Commerce Ministry’s own sources.

The Department of Commerce should show the data-vintage date on every TIA Portal total and publish a note when it differs from TRADESTAT or PIB, so a $451.07bn export figure sitting about $9.3bn above the other two sources is explained rather than left to readers.

DGCI&S should provide a documented, open download interface for TRADESTAT that does not require a browser session and returns all fiscal years in one request, so an eight-year balance can be rebuilt without session cookies and CSRF tokens.

RBI should publish its Non-factor Services series in US dollars, with its official fiscal-year average exchange rate, in the same machine-readable release as the rupee series, so analysts do not have to convert with their own averages before setting services against the goods deficit.
